jobs.description:
Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.
